answers.core:
Substitution Animation is useful in game development as it's easy and "fast" to make.
The add-on works fine, but I believe a large quantity of people would benefit from having it built-in. It fixes some annoyances when dealing with frame animation inside AnimationPlayer which is a major limitation of the Animation System in Godot.
answers.workaround: No, it'd need at least a full add-on. because it needs an user interface.
